notes.title: Alternative solution for game launcher not working
notes.content:
If you run into issues where the game is not launching, the following solution may be of assistance:

Go into C:\Program Files x86\Steam. 

Double Click the Steam Apps folder. 

Double Click the Common folder.

Double Click the Living Legends 2 Pack folder.

Inside this folder, you will see 2 game folders. 

Simply double click on each of the game folders, and create a desktop shortcut for the EXE files.

You can now play the games.
